options.name: match_sector_size
options.description: Specifies whether all returned disks must have the same (logical) sector size.

options.name: max_return
options.description: Sets the maximum number of unused disks to return.

options.name: max_size
options.description: Specifies the maximum disk size to return an unused disk.

options.name: min_size
options.description: Specifies the minimum disk size to return an unused disk.

options.name: with_interface
options.description: Specifies which disk interface will be accepted (scsi, virtio, nvme).
